shared_elements: grid of rectangular/rounded glyph blocks in rows and columns
cartouche-like rounded square signs with internal infill details
zoomorphic/anthropomorphic head signs in profile within blocks
paired sign clusters (main sign with attached smaller affixes)
raised relief carving of dense text field covering entire surface
justification: Both surfaces depict the same distinctive content: a dense, fully covered field of rounded-square glyph cartouches arranged in ordered rows and paired columns, each main sign carrying smaller attached affixes and many containing profile zoomorphic or human-like heads with the same eye and mouth conventions in low raised relief. The only real difference in depicted content is the shaping of the field to a curved, tapering column in A versus a flat rectangular panel in B, which changes the block sequence's visible layout but not the motifs or their internal relationships.
